title: LLM-assisted analysis and branch replay
input_boundary: Verified P1 Positions and canonical read model plus attributable P2 Method results
scope: A provider-neutral natural-language analysis boundary and framework-owned possibility graph that can validate, materialize, evaluate, retain, resume, compare, and assess traceable branches under explicit resource budgets.
non_goals: private, Kimi, Babata, or real company data
automatic canonical promotion of model output or forecast realization
a fixed branching factor, fixed search depth, or one required search algorithm
provider quality claims, real-provider availability claims, or product acceptance

criteria.expected: A provider-neutral asynchronous AnalysisPort accepts a frozen structured context and returns validated proposals; a deterministic offline adapter and one configurable structured-output LLM adapter implement the same contract.

Every analysis run binds the exact root/current Position projection, evidence cutoff, branch path, profile snapshot, perspective, objectives, Method runs, provider/model configuration, and context manifest in a deterministic identity.
Malformed, dangling, mode-invalid, or identity-conflicting model output fails closed and cannot write evidence, Claims, Events, Relations, Flows, States, or human review records.

Schema migration ownership stores Analysis runs, frozen contexts, Variations, derived Positions, Evaluations, search runs/frontier, cache identities, observation coverage, and Forecast Assessments as attributable possibility/derived data.

Every Variation has exactly one immutable purpose: forecast, counterfactual, or exploratory. Hypothetical/predicted branches remain separate from canonical Main Line history through pin, fork, resume, and later assessment.

Search uses configurable depth, materialized-Position, analysis-call, elapsed-time, token, and monetary-cost budgets. Candidate count is context-dependent, and selection/pruning rationale remains inspectable.
The search frontier is persisted. A budget-stopped or explicitly paused run can resume without repeating completed expansions, while cancellation and exhaustion remain explicit terminal states.

Every materialized branch Position receives a traceable multi-Party vector Evaluation in the same transaction; unexpanded proposals are retained only as unevaluated candidates and are not called Positions.

Checkout is read-only; pin preserves hypothetical mode; fork retains the selected parent and siblings; exact cache identity reuses unchanged analysis; a changed cutoff, path, profile, objective, Method, provider configuration, or policy does not reuse stale output.

Forecast Assessment is append-only, forecast-only, many-to-many, and bound to the frozen forecast, actual evidence, horizon, rubric, and observation coverage. Expired-unobserved requires elapsed horizon plus adequate coverage; silence remains pending or unknown.

A fully synthetic offline workflow projects a P1 Position, uses attributable P2 results, explores and resumes a multi-level P3 branch graph, pins/forks/replays it, appends a separate actual outcome, and assesses an eligible forecast without hidden state.

P0-P2 behavior remains compatible and the clean install, runtime tests, typecheck, build, contract validators, repository/public-boundary gate, and diff checks pass without private data or credentials.
